Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the payment of motor vehicle gross weight fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the payment of motor vehicle gross weight fees;amending RCW 46.16.135; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that thetransportation of farm goods is a vital component to the state'seconomic stability, development, and prosperity. The legislaturefurther finds that the option of purchasing monthly and semiannualgross weight permits provides a flexible solution to accommodatetransportation needs related to the transport of farm goods. It istherefore the intent of the legislature to ensure that the monthly andsemiannual vehicle licensing permits fees accurately correspond to theamount of permit time purchased for farm equipment.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.16.135 and 1986 c 18 s 12 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) The annual vehicle licensing fees as provided in RCW46.16.070 or 46.16.090 for any motor vehicle or combination of vehicleshaving a declared gross weight in excess of twelve thousand pounds maybe paid for any full registration month or months, except as provided p. 1 HB 2227in (b) of this subsection, at onetwelfth of the usual annual fee plustwo dollars, this sum to be multiplied by the number of full months forwhich the fees are paid if for less than a full year. An additionalfee of two dollars shall be collected each time a license fee is paid. (b) For the first month that vehicle license fees are paid pursuantto this section based on the licensing fees under RCW 46.16.090, thefee shall be reduced. The reduced amount shall equal onetwelfth ofthe usual annual fee plus two dollars, the sum of which shall bemultiplied by a factor. The factor shall equal the number of days thata motor vehicle or combination of vehicles is actually licensed underthis section during the first registration month divided by the totalnumber of days in the registration month. (2) Operation of a vehicle licensed under the provisions of thissection by any person upon the public highways after the expiration ofthe monthly license is a traffic infraction, and in addition the personshall be required to pay a license fee for the vehicle involvedcovering an entire registration year's operation, less the fees for anyregistration month or months of the registration year already paid.If, within five days, no license fee for a full registration year hasbeen paid as required aforesaid, the Washington state patrol, countysheriff, or city police shall impound such vehicle in such manner asmay be directed for such cases by the chief of the Washington statepatrol, until such requirement is met.
